message.content:
This editorial illustration features the masthead "TEMPO" in large, black serif letters, with "50 Tahun!" written in black script below. Additional text at the top reads "JEJARING GOLKAR DI SUAP PENYIDIK KPK / MENANTI AKSI ASEAN DI MYANMAR". 

The main imagery depicts a grey sea under a pale sky. In the foreground, a yellow outline of a broken submarine is drawn onto the water's surface, as if it were a chalk outline at a crime scene. The outline is split into three main sections. Five figures in white forensic suits and two figures in darker civilian clothing are positioned around or within this outline. Some kneel or stand while examining the water, one appears to be taking a photograph, and another looks down at a handheld device. Small yellow markers are placed near the outline. 

In the background, a grey naval vessel floats on the horizon. The headline "TAKDIR TRAGIS NANGGALA" appears in large, white, bold sans-serif font, followed by a smaller Indonesian paragraph. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, QR code, and publication details: "3-9 MEI 2021", "RP 45.000", and "ISSN: 0125 - 4273".
